description: Use to keep a service for less: weigh a retention offer the user holds, or ask for one. To cancel, use get_exit_plan. Returns documented offer routes with sources and freshness, the cost comparison (modeled_savings with every term; else savings_estimate under named assumptions and a break-even price) and request/counter/decline scripts. Sends nothing; eligibility is unknown until the vendor confirms. Amounts use the current bill's currency and cadence. Stackcut stores the arguments of tool calls to improve its recommendations (vendor names, prices, seats, features, usage numbers, billing amounts and project descriptions; account keys only as a one-way hash, billing and validation sources not at all; never IP addresses). Tool results are summarized; exit tools log only result counts, qualification flags and public evidence statuses, not answer contents. Don't send personal data or secrets.

fees.description: All mandatory fees over the comparison period; explicit 0 only if confirmed.

monthly_spend.description: Current bill. Despite the legacy property name, specify whether this amount is monthly or annual.

offer_duration_months.description: How long the offer price lasts
